SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_spend, COUNT(*) AS beverage_items
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(p.product_type) = 'beverage'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY beverage_spend DESC
LIMIT 10
